To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

SiO2- IMI as smart nanocontainers can be facilely synthesized and uniformly distributed into SiO2 sol, and the SiO2-Imidazoline@Superhydrophobic Sol-Gel Composite Coating (SiO2 -IMI@SHCSC) with self-healing function was prepared by dip-coating method.

SiO2-Imidazoline nanocarriers with dual acid/alkali triggered release function were synthesized and used as “guest” materials to construct self-healing coatings with a superhydrophilic surface on AA2024, which can effectively suppress corrosion spread and maintain the protective ability for a long time in 0.05 M NaCl solution.

a facile synthesis method of acid/alkali responsive SiO2-Imidazoline nanocontainers (SiO2–IMI) was proposed, and SiO2- IMI@SHSC with a superhydrophilic/superhydrophobic surface were fabricated to realize a self-healing coating with high corrosion resistance and excellent anti-corrosive durability.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the development of a new type of smart nanocontainers for the fabrication of a self-healing coating with superhydrophobic surfaces, which can be used to inhibit corrosion of AA2024 in a wide range of environments.
a facile and green strategy to construct a self-healing superhydrophobic coating with a dual-acid/alkali dual-responsive smart nanocontainer.

the design and fabrication of a smart nanocontainer with high loading capacity, good compatibility and dual-stimuli accelerated release property, which is a new strategy for constructing a self-healing coating with superhydrophobic surfaces.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
this work provides an innovative strategy for the design and preparation of smart nanocontainers as key components to construct self-healing coatings with superhydrophobic surfaces.

this work provides a facile, efficient and environmentally friendly approach to prepare smart nanocontainers with a special dual-stimuli release property and superhydrophobic coating, which can be widely applied in self-healing corrosion protection.
the self-healing coating with superhydrophobic surfaces (SiO2-imidazole@SHSC) was successfully fabricated via a facile one-step method.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
SiO2- IMI as “guests” were synthesized via a simple one-step modified Stober method.
the self-healing ability of SiO2-based coating with superhydrophobic surfaces can be significantly improved by the incorporation of smart nanocontainers.

SiO2-Imidazoline nanocapsules can be synthesized by a facile method and can be applied to the construction of a self-healing coating with a super-hydrophobic surface, which can be used to replace the traditional chromate conversion coating.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the smart nanocontainers with dual-stimuli-responsive release property and superhydrophobic surfaces can serve as key components for construction of self-healing coatings with high efficiency.

a smart nanocomposite (SiO2–IMI) was successfully synthesized via a facile modified Stöber process and was used to prepare a self-healing coating with a super hydrophobic surface on AA2024, which can inhibit localized corrosion and remain its protection ability for a long time.
the SiO2-Imidazoline nanocapsules can act as an effective corrosion inhibitor and can also be used as a smart nanocontainer in the construction of superhydrophobic coatings.
